summary.text: Peirous the warrior, co-captain with Acamas of the Thracians whom the strong stream of the Hellespont encloseth — named only in the Catalogue of Ships beside his slain comrade.

story.text: Homer sets Peirous beside Eüssorus' son Acamas at the head of the Thracian allies from the shores enclosed by the Hellespont. The poet names Peirous only in the muster-roll; his brother-captain meets his end when Agamemnon breaks the Trojan battalions in the sixth book.
